strings.Magoo é um personagem de um desenho de 1: Magoo is a character from a 1949 cartoon, with some episodes broadcast in Brazil in the 1970s and 1980s. So if you know who Magoo is, you're probably well over 40... :)

strings.Durante o desenvolvimento de diferentes: While developing various courses and lessons, students often asked where they could look up component interaction patterns. However, the references we had were either in English, in books such as Alan Cooper's About Face, or in libraries no longer updated, such as Yahoo YUI (User Interface Library). In that context, this library began as a resource for training delivered by Marcelo Sales.
strings.Já o nome \"Magoo\" foi criado com outro: The name "Magoo" was originally created for other purposes, but the projects were brought together with the idea of publishing this library openly.
strings.Preciso instalar algo para usar o Magoo?: Do I need to install anything to use Magoo?
strings.Não. Você pode consultar todos os compon: No. You can browse all components directly on this website. Installing Node.js and setting up the MCP are only necessary to connect the library to an assistant that supports local servers.

strings.Não. O Magoo oferece documentação de com: No. Magoo provides documentation of interaction behaviors. The package exposes this content through a read-only MCP; visual and functional implementation remains part of your design system, using your team's technologies.

strings.Em um assistente compatível, peça orient: In a compatible assistant, ask for guidance on states, keyboard navigation, focus, and acceptance criteria. Use the responses to document decisions and specifications. The Magoo MCP does not create or modify files in Figma or other design tools.
